# apple_game_center_matchmaking_team (Resource)

Adds a team to a Game Center matchmaking rule set, for matches that put players in teams. Import it with `<rule_set_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_matchmaking_team" "red" {
  rule_set_id    = apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set.ranked.id
  reference_name = "red"
  min_players    = 1
  max_players    = 4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max_players` (Number) Most players in the team.
- `min_players` (Number) Fewest players in the team.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the team, which rules refer to. Changing it creates a new team.
- `rule_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the rule set, e.g. `apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set.example.id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the matchmaking team.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_matchmaking_team.example
  identity = {
    rule_set_id = "2e4a6c8b-0d1f-4b3a-9c5e-7f8a9b0c1d2f"
    id          = "8a0c2e4f-6b1d-4a3c-8e5f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the matchmaking team.
- `rule_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the matchmaking rule set.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_matchmaking_team.example 2e4a6c8b-0d1f-4b3a-9c5e-7f8a9b0c1d2f/8a0c2e4f-6b1d-4a3c-8e5f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
```
